on highlightHoveredWord
	// DECLARE LOCAL VARIABLES
	local tMouseLoc, tCharPos, tWordNum, tFieldText, tChar, tIndex, tFieldReference, tStack, tGroupName, tStartChar, tEndChar, i, tWord
	local tCurrentWord, tPreviousWord, tPreviousStyle, tPreviousColor
	
	put QuestionInputFieldID into tGroupName
	put "field " & quote & "field" & quote & " of group " & quote & "field cs control " & tGroupName & quote into tFieldReference
	
	// SET STACK
	if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
		 put " of stack " & quote & "Appli_Player" & quote after tFieldReference
	else
		 put " of stack " & quote & "Appli" & quote after tFieldReference
	end if
	
	if exists(tFieldReference) = true then
		 if the mouseloc is within the rect of tFieldReference then
			 
			 -- Initialize previous word tracking
			 put empty into tPreviousWord
			 
			 repeat while the mouseLoc is within the rect of tFieldReference
				 put mousechar() into tCharPOS
				 put mouseChunk() into tCurrentWord
				 
				 if tCharpos > 0 then
					 -- Check if we moved to a different word
					 if tCurrentWord is not tPreviousWord then
						 
						 -- Restore previous word formatting if there was one
						 if tPreviousWord is not empty then
							 set the textStyle of tPreviousWord to tPreviousStyle
							 set the textColor of tPreviousWord to tPreviousColor
						 end if
						 
						 -- Store original formatting of current word before changing it
						 put the textStyle of tCurrentWord into tPreviousStyle
						 put the textColor of tCurrentWord into tPreviousColor
						 
						 -- Highlight the current word under mouse
						 set the textStyle of tCurrentWord to "bold"
						 set the textColor of tCurrentWord to "red"
						put tCurrentWord into lastHoveredWord 
						 --Remember this word as the previous word for next iteration
						 put (tCurrentWord) into tPreviousWord
					 end if
				 else
					 // Mouse not over text, restore previous word if any
					 if tPreviousWord is not empty then
						 set the textStyle of tPreviousWord to tPreviousStyle
						 set the textColor of tPreviousWord to tPreviousColor
						 put empty into tPreviousWord
					 end if
				 end if
				 put getWordNumberSimple(tCurrentWord,tFieldReference)
				 wait 10 milliseconds with messages
			 end repeat
			 
			 -- Clean up when mouse leaves the field - restore last highlighted word
			 if tPreviousWord is not empty then
				 set the textStyle of tPreviousWord to tPreviousStyle
				 set the textColor of tPreviousWord to tPreviousColor
			 end if
		 end if
	end if
end highlightHoveredWord

function getWordNumberSimple pChunkString, pFieldRef
	local tChunkString, tCharStart, tWordNum, tFieldText, tTextUpToChar, tOfPos
	
	if pChunkString is empty then
		 put clickChunk() into tChunkString
	else
		 put pChunkString into tChunkString
	end if
	
	-- Extract just the starting character number
	-- From "char 5 to 12 of field 1" get "5"
	put word 2 of tChunkString into tCharStart
	
	if tCharStart is a number and tCharStart > 0 then
		 if pFieldRef is not empty then
			 -- Use provided field reference
			 put the text of pFieldRef into tFieldText
		 else
			 -- Extract field reference from chunk string
			 put offset(" of ", tChunkString) into tOfPos
			 put char (tOfPos + 4) to -1 of tChunkString into tFieldRef
			 put the text of tFieldRef into tFieldText
		 end if
		 
		 -- Get text up to the character position and count words
		 put char 1 to tCharStart of tFieldText into tTextUpToChar
		 put the number of words in tTextUpToChar into tWordNum
		 
		 return tWordNum
	end if
	
	return 0
end getWordNumberSimple
